free_parameters.name: bsz
free_parameters.why: batch size does not enter the q_len guard; 1 is the smallest value the vLLM path accepts

free_parameters.name: head_dim
free_parameters.why: small power-of-two head width for CPU execution; irrelevant to the branch

free_parameters.name: head_id
free_parameters.why: selects the single best_pattern entry; any valid index is equivalent

free_parameters.name: dtype
free_parameters.why: CPU environment has no float16 flash-attention support; guard is dtype-independent

free_parameters.name: seed
free_parameters.why: fixed seed for reproducibility; the guard does not depend on values

free_parameters.name: pattern_type
free_parameters.why: one of the three vLLM fc entries; q_len=1 returns before it is used

execution.entry_reason: The step-4 call chain [gather_last_q_vertical_slash_topk_v4, gather_last_q_vertical_slash_topk_vllm] is not a real path: v4 never calls vllm, and vllm is only reached from minference_vllm_forward, which needs a GPU vLLM install unavailable on this CPU box. The Region's own function is therefore called directly with a minimal best_pattern, at full witness scale for the guard variable q_len.

mocks.reason: repository module imports pycuda/flash_attn and a Triton CUDA kernel at import time; the vllm fc mapping is not executed for q_len=1 and the negative uses a patched block_sparse_attention
imports minference.cuda and Triton GPU kernels at module import time; none of its symbols are used by the Region
imports Triton GPU kernels at module import time; streaming_forward is a different fc mapping not taken by this witness
minference_forward.py builds LAST_Q_MASK at import time with device='cuda'; the CPU stand-in computes the same integer sequence and ignores only the device request
the negative q_len=2 path reaches the Triton block-sparse kernel, which cannot run on CPU; the stand-in reimplements the repository's block-choice rule and masked attention in plain torch

hooks.name: synthetic_package_scaffold
hooks.purpose: the repository package __init__ imports the unavailable vLLM/HF patch layer; empty package containers with the real package __path__ let the Region's source file be imported unchanged (no code is replaced)
